Bangladesh beats Bhutan 1-0 in a close contest at the SAFF Championship 2026; Highlights
 BAN vs BHU Highlights: Catch the real-time updates from the Bangladesh vs Bhutan SAFF Championship 2026 Group A match being played in Bangladesh.
 Updated : Nov 05, 2026 21:39 IST 
 Sportstar News Desk 
 Comments
 Follow Us 
 SHARE

 The opening match of Group A in the SAFF Championship is Bangladesh vs Bhutan 
 | Photo Credit: 
 Bangladesh Football Federation/X
 The opening match of Group A in the SAFF Championship is Bangladesh vs Bhutan
 | Photo Credit: 
 Bangladesh Football Federation/X
 Welcome to Sportstar’s highlights of the Bangladesh vs Bhutan SAFF Championship 2026 Group A match being played in Bangladesh. 
 MATCH OVERVIEW 
 Venue: Bangabandhu National Stadium
 Kick-off time: 7:30 p.m. IST
 November 05, 2026 21:36 
 Sri Lanka up next
 Both teams will face Sri Lanka next, Bhutan on Sunday (8th) and Bangladesh on Wednesday (11th). 
 That game is set to be tougher for both teams and will be very important if either wants to progress to the next rounds.
 November 05, 2026 21:34 
 Tough game for both teams
 Recovery will be essential to both teams, as they look to improve their performances. 
Bangladesh will get more players joining their squad, which will be a big boost. 
Bhutan needs to find a way to create chances, maybe through set pieces, and not just hold out for a draw
 November 05, 2026 21:32 
 Full-time whistle blows!
 Bangladesh has won its opening fixture 1-0 against Bhutan!
It was a tough match, where the players had to endure gruelling conditions and fight against their own fitness. 
Bangladesh created the clearer chances and was able to convert one in the second half. The hosts will want to be more clinical in front of goal in the upcoming matches if it wants to go far in the competition. 
 Bhutan provided a good contest to Bangladesh as it dug in and made the game as difficult as possible for the eventual winners.
 November 05, 2026 21:27 
 Bangladesh chance!
 Saad Uddin jumps the highest to a corner and almost connects perfectly.
The Bhutan goalkeeper made a complete mess of that block attempt.
 November 05, 2026 21:25 
 5 minutes added on
 The 4th official is not being kind to the muscles of the weary players. 
However, Bhutan would welcome the chance to get one final chance to equalise.
Some rhythm would help the team, instead of the stop-start game we are seeing right now
 November 05, 2026 21:22 
 2 Minutes to go (plus added time)
 The sting has been taken out of the game with all the injuries and substitutions. 
No flowing attacks or passage of play are being shown anymore. 
Long balls and fouls more common.
 November 05, 2026 21:21 
 Bhutan Substitutions
 Jetsuen Dorji, Sonam Dorji and Jigdrel Wangchuk on
Tenzin Norbu, Tshelthrim Namgyel and Kingzan Tashi Tobden off
 November 05, 2026 21:19 
 Yellow card for Bangladesh
 Fahamedul Islam picks up a yellow card for a tactical foul to stop a Bhutan attack.
 November 05, 2026 21:18 
 Tiredness and injuries piling on
 Both teams look weary and in pain after every burst of energy now.
More substitutions could be on the way
 November 05, 2026 21:15 
 10 minutes left
 Bhutan need to find a gear that it might not have left to have any chance of coming back in this match. 
1-0 to Bangladesh still
 November 05, 2026 21:14 
 Bangladesh Substitutions 
 Mohammad Riddoy and Rahmat Mia come on for Quazem Kirmanee and Zayyan Ahmed.
 November 05, 2026 21:08 
 Another chance for Bangladesh
 Their 1000th cross of the day (sarcastic) delivered by Rakib Hossain, is headed close by Saad Uddin.
The team is going to stick to their cross-and-hope tactics.
 November 05, 2026 21:03 
 GOAL BANGLADESH!
 1 - 0 for Bangladesh, 70 minutes in
It is the super sub; Mohammad Ibrahim comes on and immediately delivers for his side!
It is a sloppy goal to concede for Bhutan, however. The ball bounces around the box before Ibrahim gets his foot to it.
 To be fair to Bangladesh, the goal does come from a cross. The nation has not stopped trying to score a goal like this all game.
 November 05, 2026 21:01 
 Bangladesh Substitutions
 Sohel Rana and Mohammad Ibrahim have been subbed on for Jamal Bhuyan (captain) and Bishwanath Ghosh
 November 05, 2026 20:57 
 Yellow Card - Bangladesh
 Zayyan Ahmed is shown a yellow card for a late challenge on a Bhutan winger
 November 05, 2026 20:55 
 Bhutan Substitution
 Kinga Wangchuk comes in for Dawa Tshering
62 minutes
 November 05, 2026 20:54 
 Scruffy Game
 The match has become more filled with mistakes and more end-to-end. 
This is good for Bhutan, as they are able to get on the ball more, and their captain is trying to use his vision to create some chances. 
Bangladesh need to find its composure again. 
60 minutes
 November 05, 2026 20:50 
 Freekick for Bangladesh
 Jamal Bhuyan takes another set piece for his side. 
It is immediately cleared by Bhutan, and it sets out on a counterattack. 
Bhutan captain Chencho seemed to have been clipped by the Bangladesh defender; however, the referee does not see any problem with it. 
54 minutes in
 November 05, 2026 20:45 
 The game's pattern continues
 Bangladesh are sticking to their cross and hope tactics. 
Some early crosses have been added to the repertoire.
 November 05, 2026 20:44 
 Second Half Begins
 Foysal Fahim has been replaced by another left-footed winger, Fahamedul Islam.
 November 05, 2026 20:23 
 First Half ends
 Bangladesh has definitely been the better team, with more possession and control. 
They have relied on crosses from their pacy wingers, but there has been no end product from the side. 
Bhutan will be happier of the two, as the underdogs. The side came into the game to frustrate Bangladesh with its low block, and it has definitely done that. 
However, Bhutan has been restricted to just long shots and will want more attacking plays in the second half.
Bangladesh 0 - 0 Bhutan
 November 05, 2026 20:20 
 2 Minutes added on
 The first half is almost over, as just two minutes are added on.
 November 05, 2026 20:18 
 Freekick for Bangladesh
 Bangladesh have earned a free kick from the edge of the box at 43 minutes.
The captain, Jamal Bhuyan, steps up to take the kick and puts it in a good area. 
Shamit Shome flicks the ball at the near post, but no other player in green is able to turn it into the goal
 November 05, 2026 20:13 
 Good run from Bangladesh
 Bishwanath Ghosh makes a great run behind the defence as Rakib Hossain finds him perfectly.
A little bobble off the ground, and his shot is wayward. 
 40 Minutes
 November 05, 2026 20:12 
 Bangladesh's Tactics
 The hosts might want to switch its tactics from spamming crosses to trying to force the play through the middle. 
Bangladesh is not able to reach the end of most of these crosses.
 November 05, 2026 20:10 
 Chencho Gyeltshen's one-man attack
 The captain and Bhutan’s top scorer in history runs past the Bangladesh defenders to earn Bhutan a corner. 
The corner is not put into a good area, and nothing comes out of it.
 November 05, 2026 20:07 
 Injury Update
 Orgyen Wangchuk has been taken to the hospital after the collision that injured his head. 
It looked like he was dazed when he left the field. 
Wish him well in his recovery!
 November 05, 2026 20:05 
 30 Minutes
 Bhutan have not managed a single promising attack yet.
Their low block is frustrating Bangladesh, as the hosts is unable to break the ‘Dragon Boys’ down
 November 05, 2026 20:03 
 Injury Scare
 Nima Wangdi clears the ball for a Bangladesh corner
But in the process of kicking the ball away, his foot gets stuck in the ground, and he seems to have hurt himself. 
Another injury would be bad for Bhutan.
He seems to be okay to continue for now
 November 05, 2026 20:02 
 Handball appeal
 Bangladesh appeal for a handball after its shot on goal is blocked by Bhutan’s defender.
The referee dismisses the shouts for a penalty
24 minutes
 November 05, 2026 19:55 
 20 Minutes 
 The match has been controlled by Bangladesh so far.
All the chances have come from crosses for the home side. Bishwanath is looking the most likely to score for his side
 November 05, 2026 19:53 
 Substitution - Bhutan
 Orgyen Wangchuk is unable to continue and is replaced by Kingzan Tenzin
 November 05, 2026 19:48 
 15 Minutes - Score Update
 Bangladesh 0 - 0 Bhutan
 November 05, 2026 19:47 
 Bhutan - Low press
 Bhutan are letting Bangladesh have possession until it reaches their defensive third.
To counter their low press, Bangladesh are using long balls to get past the block.
 November 05, 2026 19:46 
 Clash of heads
 Orgyen Wangchuk rises up to win a second ball but gets caught by the Bangladesh defender. 
He looks dazed and will take some time out before hopefully continuing 
 November 05, 2026 19:44 
 Zangpo denies Bishwanath
 Bishwanath chases after a long ball, using his strength to get past the defender.
But Zangpo is alert again and rushes towards the ball, denying a good shooting opportunity
 November 05, 2026 19:41 
 Save by Zangpo!
 Bhutan don’t deal with the first corner of the match for Bangladesh, as the shot comes in from the edge of the box.
Zangpo is alert to Fahim’s shot and is able to push it away. 
 November 05, 2026 19:39 
 Cross by Rakib
 Rakib Hossain races past the Bhutan left back and lifts a cross to the far post, however, Bhutan are able to deal with it and clear the ball
 November 05, 2026 19:37 
 Confident start
 The hosts has began the game with confidence as they knock the ball about and press high as Bhutan receives the ball
 November 05, 2026 19:34 
 Kick off!
 Bangladesh kicking left to right
 November 05, 2026 19:30 
 National Anthems!
 Both teams line up on the field as the national anthems play
Kickoff soon!
 November 05, 2026 19:25 
 Bhutan Starting XI
 Gyeltshen Zangpo (GK), Tenzin Norbu, Kingzan Tashi Tobden, Sonam Phunthso, Nima Wangdi, Jigman Seltob Dorji, Tshelthrim Namgyel, Orgyen Wangchuk, Pema Zangpo, Dawa Tshering, Chencho Gyletshen (Captain)
 November 05, 2026 19:06 
 Bangladesh Starting XI
 Md Mehdi Hasan Sarbon (GK), Zayyan Ahmed, Tariq Kazi, Saad Uddin, Quazem Kirmanee, Jamal Bhuyan (captain), Shamit Shome, Rakib Hossain, Md Foysal Ahmed Fahim, Zidane Yousuf, Bishwanath Ghosh
 November 05, 2026 18:44 
 Last Meeting
 The last time Bangladesh and Bhutan met was in June 2025 at the same venue as today’s match. The result was 2-0 in favour of Bangladesh.
 November 05, 2026 18:40 
 Bangladesh vs Bhutan - Head-to-head record
 Played - 14
Bangladesh - 10
 Bhutan - 2
 Draws - 2
 November 05, 2026 18:37 
 Match Preview
 Bangladesh and Bhutan face off in the opening fixture in Group A. 
The hosts are coming off a third-place finish in the last edition of the SAFF Championship and will be hoping to equal if not better its result.
Bhutan, on the other hand, did not have a good tournament as they lost all three of their matches. The nation will be hopeful to have a better return than just two goals scored this time around. 
The top two teams from the group will qualify for the semifinals; one win will likely confirm that result, however, topping the group will give the teams a favourable draw.
 November 05, 2026 18:27 
 Bangladesh vs Bhutan - Where to watch the match
 The Bangladesh vs Bhutan SAFF Championship 2026 match will not be telecast in India. However, the match will be livestreamed on the Veto app and website. 
 November 05, 2026 18:26
